name: jlcpcb-mcp
description: Find and evaluate JLCPCB/LCSC parts for PCB assembly: live search, stock, prices, alternatives.
long_description: Live parametric search of the JLCPCB assembly parts library (Basic / Preferred / Extended), live JLCPCB assembly stock and LCSC retail stock with price breaks, datasheets, cheaper or better-stocked substitutes, the category tree, and a clearly-labelled approximate bare-PCB cost model. No credentials required; official JLCPCB API credentials are optional.

tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Live JLCPCB/LCSC parts search with category, package, Basic-only and stock filters

tools.name: get_component_details
tools.description: Live stock, price breaks, parameters, datasheet and image for an LCSC part

tools.name: suggest_alternatives
tools.description: Cheaper, better-stocked or Basic-library substitutes for a part

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: JLCPCB category tree with live part counts

tools.name: estimate_pcb_quote
tools.description: Approximate bare-PCB cost model (not an official quote)

jlcpcb_app_id.title: JLCPCB API app id (optional)
jlcpcb_app_id.description: Official JLCPCB Open API app id. Leave empty to use the public endpoints only.

jlcpcb_api_key.title: JLCPCB API access key (optional)
jlcpcb_api_key.description: Official JLCPCB Open API access key.
